decisions.reason: This low-pile decorative carpet is close to the core offer, still has its own page in 2024, and costs little to keep listed, so the option stays open while demand becomes clearer.
This premium hand-knotted wool silk carpet fits the craftsmanship positioning, remains prominently presented, and has low holding costs, so its value is still worth waiting to learn.
The Ison corner bench moved from its own page to a mention, but it is still promoted as a new interpretation, so its prospects remain uncertain and are not yet clearly negative.
This low-pile carpet sits in a crowded carpet range where sibling Product C was already pruned, but it remains on its own page, so continued presence signals it survived the first culling.
The swivel shell chair is close to the established seating offer, is consistently presented, and is a cheap option with plausible project demand, so the firm keeps it.
